name: @atrium/agent-runner
comment:where-this-runs: THIS PACKAGE RUNS INSIDE THE WORKSPACE CONTAINER (SECURITY.md boundary 2).
It is the ONLY workspace allowed to depend on @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk.
apps/server sits above the AgentProvider seam (apps/server/src/agent/provider.ts)
and must never import the SDK: that seam is what keeps a local model, or a
second harness, a config change rather than a refactor (PLAN.md 4, 10.0).
It is also semi-hostile ground. Everything in this process's environment is
readable by a prompt-injected agent, so the only two secrets-shaped values it
may ever receive are ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (the broker sidecar) and a short-lived
workspace-scoped capability token (D1, T2). Never a provider credential.
